content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NAM Kerala Ayurveda Therapist Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Ayush Mission Kerala (NAM Kerala) for the Kasaragod district healthcare sector under District Ayush Health Society.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Ayurveda Therapist under contract basis for healthcare services across designated facilities in Kasaragod, Kerala.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Ayurveda Therapist post under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Ayurveda Therapist?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an Ayurveda Therapist Course conducted by the Government of Kerala or a 1-year Ayurveda Therapist course from NARIP Cheruthuruthi.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 40 years as on the notification date. Please verify relaxation norms from the official PDF.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Ayurveda Therapist post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of 14,700/-.

faq.question: Q7. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 08 October 2026 at the designated venue in Kasaragod.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via Walk-in Interview. Candidates must attend in person with all required documents and certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at DPMSU Kasaragod (Padanakkad District Ayurveda Hospital, A Block, 2nd Floor), Pincode 671315.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No application fee is required to be paid by candidates for attending this walk-in interview as per the official notification details.
